item.title: Rent Increase Notice: How to Respond at Renewal (2026)
item.description:
Quick Answer

Confirm the effective date and response deadline first — missing the deadline can lock you into the new rate or trigger a notice to vacate. Break the increase into base rent plus fees, compare the total against your budget, and counteroffer politely if it no longer fits.

See what you can actually afford with the Rent Budget Calculator. A rent increase notice can feel like a surprise, even when you expect one. The real question is not just whether the number is higher. It is whether the total cost still fits your budget and whether the renewal terms make sense for your life right now.
